description: This repository contains gzipped files containing more than 2 million tokens (words) from answers submitted by more than 6,000 students over the course of their first 30 days of using Duolingo. It also contains baseline starter code written in Python. There are three data sets, corresponding to three different language courses. More details on the data set and task are available at: http://sharedtask.duolingo.com.
